title: Multimodal Machine Learning in Mental Health: A Survey of Data, Algorithms, and Challenges

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying and evaluating the reporting of gender demographics and balance across 26 multimodal mental health datasets.
Evaluating the lack of ethnicity disclosure in existing datasets and analyzing literature for sensor placement biases (e.g., facial tracking performing worse on dark-skinned faces).
Reviewing existing datasets to determine the frequency of socio-economic status disclosure and its impact on fairness analysis.
Critiquing existing training corpora for the under-representation of certain age groups in mental health datasets.
Analyzing biases introduced by language variation, specifically highlighting the mislabelling of African American Vernacular English (AAVE).
